Wholesale & Distribution

Supplying restaurants, grocers, and distributors across the Midwest since 1962.

How Wholesale Ordering Works

  • Minimum order: 200 lbs per order, mixed cuts welcome.
  • Order lead time: Standard orders ship within 3–5 business days of confirmation.
  • Delivery area: South Dakota, Minnesota, Iowa, Nebraska, and North Dakota via our own refrigerated fleet. Other regions available via freight carrier.
  • Payment terms: Net 30 for established accounts; first orders require prepayment or COD.
  • Custom cuts: Available on request for standing wholesale accounts — talk to our sales team about spec.

Who We Supply

Restaurants

Steakhouses, BBQ joints, and independent kitchens across the region rely on us for consistent portioning and freshness.

Grocers & Meat Markets

Case-ready and butcher-counter cuts, packed to your store's specs.

Distributors

Volume pricing and reliable weekly fulfillment for regional foodservice distributors.
